newsitem.title: USA: Transitional Hospitals says may be sold.
newsitem.headline: Transitional Hospitals says may be sold.

text.p: Transitional Hospitals Corp, formerly Community Psychiatric Centers, on Thursday said it has been approached by unnamed parties about being acquired whole or in parts.

The company said one possibility includes the provision that shareholders retain pro rata interests in company unit, Behavioral Healthcare Corp. Financial details fo the proposed deals were undisclosed. The company said it has hired a financial advisor to assist it with a possible sale.
The company delivers long-term acute care through 16 hospitals and three satellite facilities in 13 states.
